parsed.post: KEEP! Massive improvement: 1.0324 -> 1.0211. It seems reducing the batch size to 262144 alongside the current LR/WD settings is a winning combination. I'll try lowering the learning rate to 0.02 to see if we can squeeze out more convergence during this final round.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps and further lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to push convergence.
